The user explicitly requested a maximum full audit and delivery. Read /home/s0u7a/projects/celtium/docs/history/2026-10-11-full-audit-1058.md (331 lines before receipts). Source cutoff 11:15:29 JST, HEAD 93f35f67fe644637c58b3843cddbfe55d5905476 plus dirty work. I did not edit implementation, stop workers, rewrite the goal, or launch another game.

Five new confirmed findings (3 P1, 2 P2), with the previous N01-N17 individually re-audited:

A01 P1, urgent: CeltiumFontGlyphCapture.submit writes four relative vertices into VERTEX (96 bytes) / ISOLATED (64), then memAddress(buffer) WITHOUT flip or explicit position. LWJGL 3.4.1 CPU measurement gives addressDelta=96/64 and remaining=0; the backend copies vertex bytes from one past the allocation. Both integrated jar d366510f5e83f06fa398147be132486780086bf73c58738f5d005ed0ad64be6a and actual recent jar 68c6f5041945395f5fc396a05d8a331b49611e4bca82f88aa70c43482302cacf contain it (latest glyph javap offsets 508/518). Live source SHA9672f3c4fe7c9f99691ebbc506519e248f123b282622f264770e9ffaeffa0fbb still has it at cutoff. Fix BOTH branches and check offered native bytes/address against captured vertices. Preserve vanilla STRIP order/UV/advance. Isolation, force-quads, matrix, and screen-fill probes shared the bad pointer, so their negative conclusions cannot isolate causes. This does not prove every terrain wedge has the same cause. Prior urgent request 93ecccdd-15d6-4394-b7fb-7a986d8ae8d0 was accepted but still in your next-turn inbox at 11:10. I am also queuing this proof to the verified existing N03 worker.

A02 P1: VulkanContext.submitWithSemaphores now has bounded vkWaitForFences, but timeout throws into an unconditional finally that vkDestroyFence/vkFreeCommandBuffers. Actual 68c6 jar confirms the exceptional cleanup (offset574/586). Queue-accepted timeout does NOT prove completion. This violates pending ownership (VUID fence-01120 / commandBuffers-00047). Separate pre-submit failure, confirmed completion, and submitted-but-incomplete timeout; quarantine pending resources and refuse further context use. Existing backend timeout acceptance does not cover this context/present path.

A03 P1: ValidationClient.referenceCalibrationKey calls calibrationKey with reference pose/scale, but calibrationKey reads CURRENT candidate worldLayers/blockSweep/allBlocks/entity flags from System properties. Thus reference variant follows the candidate. iso-glow-after-a reports reference and candidate BOTH allBlocks=true + keepEntities/captureEntities/glowEntities despite the named references being plain terrain. Fix the reference key as immutable metadata from hash-pinned measured reference runs, and CPU-check that changing candidate variant never changes reference key. Keep actual failing images FAILED; this is no justification to override the gate.

A04 P2: actual module jar helper requiredUploadBytes(Integer.MAX_VALUE,Integer.MAX_VALUE,direct4) accepts -17179869180 due to LONG overflow in width*height*4. Guard before multiplication or use checked arithmetic. Normal slice/hash tests pass and should remain.

A05 P2: each device wait watchdog shares deviceWaitFinished. Old A watchdog can inspect new B's false flag and falsely mark gpuStalled even when B just started. Use per-call completion/token/deadline and a visible stall handoff. Source-confirmed interleaving, not an observed driver hang.

Remaining ownership gaps: HostBuffer.create still lacks partial cleanup; DynamicMesh constructor leaks its first buffer if the second fails; buildModelMeshes catches only meshes already in built, not the current mesh that throws BEFORE built.put. The N17 image fault fires before vkCreateImage and is NOT partial-image cleanup coverage. N02 switch2 has actual teardown/rebuild improvement, but its probe says PASS no probe list yet, not recompile/delete acceptance.

Preserve genuine improvements: N01 vertex-loop fix, new layout token/ledger, per-mip uploads and slice hash, accurate width refusal, COUNT tables, missing benchmark controls rejection, Java21 distributable checker. Existing CPU contract and bench check independently passed; distributable68c6 has verified=true, errors=[], class65 maximum. Foreign ledger CPU5/5 and unbound=0 are useful, but actual foreign-transition abandon is still unexercised. Descriptor ring alias is prevented by throwing at slot33; preflight/boundary/GL-less coverage remain.

Latest images visually fail: w9-only67 huge triangles/nonBg0.364906 (same PNG as w6-only6); iso-glow-after-a is entirely one color/nonBg0. Both have VUID0 and process exit0 but validationExit1. n03-h-bridgestate is bridge GL text, not native glyph acceptance. Retained good pin d2073e9456da7bccf01820ba961a6564874f3cebedbbc4f83b6a99fb5789899f vs regressed c1d4e7db534651298b104c3daa43d35600c6e6961772e327d3462b41ed8c134e makes focused comparison possible. Keep the gate-failure rules in 11a826eee/93f35f67f.

Progress by contract batches with cheap CPU checks before meaningful GPU acceptance; preserve existing valid changes and worker ownership. Do not repeat one edit / one full game launch or mask sweeps indefinitely. Update the CURRENT top table, not only append corrections: plan still revision61 vs goal65; legacy bridge GUI/font acceptance and old TESR missing claims mix with new evidence; latest regression is larger than thin streaks. Keep goal ID and the user's final instructions, Cleanroom-only/release21/game25/native Vulkan/no generic GL translator, and defer shader packs until full vanilla+major mods. CELTIUM_AUDIT_20261011_1058_N03_DIRECT_CX

The user authorized a full audit delivery. This is a concrete P1 in your glyph producer, confirmed in ACTUAL jars, not another matrix or sampler guess. Full MD: /home/s0u7a/projects/celtium/docs/history/2026-10-11-full-audit-1058.md, A01.

submit(): VERTEX.clear(); then 4 relative writes *24 bytes -> position96/cap96, followed by memAddress(VERTEX) WITHOUT flip. Isolation does the same for 4*16 -> position64/cap64. LWJGL memAddress returns current position: native vertexAddress is one past the allocation. Backend copyVertices copies 96/64 bytes of unrelated native memory. LWJGL3.4.1 CPU check produced delta96/64, remaining0; flip produced delta0 and expected remaining. Actual integrated d366510... and recent68c6f5041945395f5fc396a05d8a331b49611e4bca82f88aa70c43482302cacf have it; recent submit javap memAddress offsets508/518, no flip. Live SHA9672f3c4fe7c9f99691ebbc506519e248f123b282622f264770e9ffaeffa0fbb still had it at 11:15:29.

Fix BOTH normal and isolation branches to offer first written byte with checked written extent. Verify recovered offered bytes equal your captured positions/UV/color cheaply before another GPU probe. Keep original FontRenderer strip order, italic offsets and advance. Changing only drawMode to QUADS does not preserve that strip's vertex order. All prior isolation/screen-fill/matrix glyph experiments shared the bad address; their negative conclusions must not rule out texture/matrix/routing until valid bytes are offered. No claim that every terrain wedge is this bug.

Then hash-pin real jar and accept GL-less ASCII/Unicode/decoration/shadow UI images at a meaningful batch boundary. Bridge settings text is GL and not this acceptance. Preserve other good work and coordinate normal GPU scheduling with root; no extra simultaneous game. Root has this full audit queued too.
